general_observations.evidence_notes: DOU 9 Oct 2026: Anvisa ordered recall of all lots of Peptistrong (Manipulacao Stevia Ltda / Biostevi Pharma) and suspended manufacture, distribution, sale, advertising and use, because the ingredient 'proteina de fava hidrolisada Peptistrong' had not undergone a safety evaluation for use in foods; effective on publication; no health harm reported. Reported by g1 (06:46 BRT), CNN Brasil, O Liberal, Metro1. BR marketing site says the Nuritas ingredient (2.4 g/day) is distributed exclusively by Sovita and sold only through compounding pharmacies nationwide, indicated for sarcopenia, with claims such as '4x sinalizacao mais potente que a proteina do soro do leite' and '56% de inibicao da miostatina'. Finished flavoured powder also listed on Mercado Livre (promoted on X 06:20Z Oct 9). Same basis as LiveStrong/Essential Nutrition recall RE 4.740/2025 (per search summary). Scope inference: act names the Biostevi product but the stated basis is the ingredient itself, so other products containing it are likely exposed. X: 20 posts/7d for PeptiStrong or 'proteina de fava' (1-4/day, mostly promo); CNN Brasil post 2,742 impressions in ~40 min. Related (no frozen prediction edited): NT-2026-10-05-07, NT-2026-09-21-04, NT-2026-09-28-04.

Content angle: efficacy studies do not equal regulatory safety approval; caution on 'muscle gain without training' claims.
